ModMetaData.name: Intellectual Matters
ModMetaData.description:
Intellectual Matters ties learning speed and Intellectual training together in a simple way.
Learning speed Your Intellectual skill acts like a brain-stat for the whole colony member. Higher Intellectual means they learn every skill faster; lower Intellectual means they learn slower. You can tune how strong that effect is at levels 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20.
Daily Intellectual training Pawns do not get extra Intellectual XP drip-fed while they work other jobs. Instead, once per day at local midnight, each humanlike pawn gets a lump of Intellectual XP based on how much XP they earned that day in all other skills. By default that is a small percentage of the day's total (configurable). So a busy day of crafting, shooting, plants, etc. pays off as Intellectual overnight.
Decay You can also scale how fast unused Intellectual skill decays. This only affects XP loss, not the midnight grant.
Vanilla Intellectual XP from research and similar Intellectual work is unchanged. Optional debug logging can print the midnight grant breakdown to the log.
